images.title: Rooms times diamonds in a room
images.purpose: Shows seven factors of 3 split into 3⁴ = 81 rooms and 3³ = 27 diamonds per room, giving 81 × 27 = 2187 diamonds.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One row of seven equal squares with two braces above and one long brace below.
images.exact_structure: One row of seven equal plain teal (#0072B2) squares with no text inside, evenly spaced. A small key to the left reads each square = 3. Above the first four squares, an amber (#E69F00) brace labelled 3⁴ = 81 rooms. Above the last three squares, a reddish purple (#CC79A7) brace labelled 3³ = 27 per room. Below all seven squares, one long dark brace labelled 3⁷ = 2187 diamonds. Exactly 7 squares and 3 braces. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Seven factors of 3 split into rooms and diamonds per room: 81 × 27 = 2187.
images.description: Shows seven factors of 3 split into 3⁴ = 81 rooms and 3³ = 27 diamonds per room, giving 81 × 27 = 2187 diamonds.

image_decisions.why: Splitting one row of factors into two groups shows why one multiplication, 81 × 27, gives the diamonds.
